title: ‘The Beauty’ Costume Designer Explains the Show’s Cinematic Influences — and When She Broke from Them
summary: At IndieWire's Craft Roundtables, Sarah Evelyn broke down the show's precise color coding and explained why references can only take you so far.

title: ‘Industry’ Titans: How Myha’la and Marisa Abela Evolved Into the ‘Emotional Axis’ of the HBO Series
summary: "Industry" stars Myha'la and Marisa Abela, plus show creators Mickey Down and Konrad Kay, map out how their characters Harper and Yasmin became the central dynamic driving HBO's financial thriller.

title: Watch ‘Love Story’ Costume Designer Rudy Mance Explain the ‘Crazy, Obsessive’ Lengths He Went to Recreate Iconic Looks
summary: To tell the story of John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette, Mance relied on an extensive photo archive and two very supportive actors. He broke down his process at IndieWire's Craft Roundtables.

title: ‘Ocean with David Attenborough’ Director Keith Scholey Explains Why Everyone Should Be Hopeful About Ocean Conservation
summary: At a special Pass the Remote screening presented by Disney, the documentarian explained why preserving our oceans is a topic that should unite humans of all stripes.

title: The New ‘Cape Fear’ Series Builds on the Martin Scorsese Classic and Brings the Heat
summary: Cinematographer Eben Bolter discusses with IndieWire the techniques he used to evoke a sense of dread, heat, and voyeurism in the Apple TV series.

title: Making a Film with My Father Helped Me Fall in Love with Acting Again
summary: Tribeca: Long-time actor Marcel Ruiz comes to this year's festival with a starring role in "Summer of Three," a film he also wrote alongside his director father, Carlitos Ruíz-Ruíz.

title: Tracy Morgan and the ‘Reggie Dinkins’ Team on What It Takes to Make a Joke-Heavy Sitcom That Still Hits Home
summary: As dense with laughs as "30 Rock" before it, the latest sitcom from Robert Carlock and Tracy Morgan still finds time to make sure the audience connects with its characters. Here's how they do it.

title: Writers Guild Foundation, USC, and More Join Partner Program for Academy’s Nicholl Fellowship Submissions
summary: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences has added new partners for Nicholl Fellowships in Screenwriting 2026-2027 submissions, including the Writers Guild Foundation as another public submissions platform.

title: The Stars of ‘Stop! That! Train!’ Open Up About the First Movie from the ‘RuPaul’s Drag Race’ Universe
summary: The cast of Adam Shankman's comedy breaks down the chaos and cacophony that went into making the Pride Month release.

title: ‘Alice and Steve’ Review: Nicola Walker Burns the House Down as a Jilted Best Friend in Hulu’s Sly Comedy
summary: "Sex Education" writer Sophie Goodhart helms Hulu's solid sitcom about a mother (Walker) willing to burn down her own life if it means preventing her twenty-something daughter (Yali Topol Margalith) from marrying her fifty-something best friend (Jemaine Clement).

title: ‘Here I’m Alive’ Review: ‘Menashe’ Director Joshua Z. Weinstein Returns with a Microbudget ‘Magnolia’ for the Age of Hypernormalization
summary: Sex workers, shut-ins, and social media influencers collide in this small but vital New York portrait of overlapping lives.

title: Rebecca Miller Pays Tribute to Martin Scorsese for His ‘Immense Honesty and Fearlessness’
summary: IndieWire Honors: At our spring event, the director of "Mr. Scorsese" thanked the director on behalf of cinephiles everywhere for his films and generosity.
